    Calculate ADF stream apportionment for existing stream segments

    get_adf_stream_apportionment.Rd

    Calculate static web or web-squared fractions assigning a pumping well's analytical stream depletion to a prepared stream-segment network.

    get_adf_stream_apportionment(
  pumping_wells,
  stream_segments,
  sample_spacing,
  method = c("web_squared", "web"),
  maximum_distance = NULL
)

    Arguments

    pumping_wells

    An `sf` pumping-well object accepted by [`.validate_pumping_wells()`]. It is transformed internally to the CRS of `stream_segments`.

    stream_segments

    A projected `sf` object returned by [get_stream_segments()].

    sample_spacing

    A scalar `units` length giving the maximum stream length represented by an apportionment sample point.

    method

    Character string selecting `"web_squared"` or `"web"`.

    maximum_distance

    Either `NULL` or a positive scalar `units` length. Sample points farther than this distance from a pump receive zero weight.

    Value

    An `sf` object with one row per pump–stream-segment pair, including `pump_to_reach_distance` and `apportionment_fraction`.

    Details

    This is the preferred ADF-specific apportionment interface. The older [get_stream_reach_apportionment()] function remains available for compatibility but combines stream segmentation and ADF apportionment in one call and is planned for deprecation.

    Examples

    stream_segments <- get_stream_segments(
  example_stream_reaches,
  units::set_units(100, "m")
)
get_adf_stream_apportionment(
  example_pumping_wells,
  stream_segments,
  sample_spacing = units::set_units(25, "m")
)
